blocks.text: Group 2 elements are metals primarily found in the earth and form alkalis; hence they are referred to as alkaline earth metals. Examples include calcium and magnesium. These elements have two electrons in their valence shell, making them divalent. They are metallic solids that are harder and denser than alkali metals. Easily oxidized, with high thermal and electrical conductivities.
